Build #2: adding FOSS apps, Bliss Touch Mapper, and basic addon_init.rc for touch & display mapping services

### Display Overrides (Displays 0 to 3)
Use these to forcefully configure external monitors or built-in screens.
- persist.ax86.display.<ID>.resolution: Target resolution (e.g., 1920x1080 or reset).
- persist.ax86.display.<ID>.dpi: Screen density (e.g., 240 or reset).
- persist.ax86.display.<ID>.orientation: Screen rotation (0=0°, 1=90°, 2=180°, 3=270°, or free).
- Apply Changes: setprop sys.ax86.display.update 1
